card.name: Under supervision of a clinician
card.fires_on: The word supervision (or supervised) right after 'under the' or 'medically' when a drug must be given with a clinician overseeing. Also nearby linking words like 'time of' or 'during' about who must be present at administration.

modes.description: The word supervision after 'administered under the' in warnings about who may give a drug.

modes.label: Presence at administration
modes.description: Linking words such as time, during or when about someone being present or available at dosing.
modes.example: Always have emergency resuscitation equipment and trained personnel available at the<< time>> of VIZAMYL administration.

card.writes: It seems to push toward word endings or pieces that follow supervision-type words, but the output tokens are mostly unrelated and unclear.
